about: Every official rule the engine must obey, where it comes from (page or section, as noted in docs/manual-notes.md), its status, and the test that proves it. Checked by tools/check_obligations.py (also run inside tests/suites/void_supply_rules_tests.py). Status: enforced = implemented and proven by the named test; partial = implemented with a known, documented gap (see note); equivalent = a different procedure with the same game result; open = not implemented yet.

obligations.rule: Each player starts with 5 Life cores and a Reserve of 3 cores plus the Soul Core; the Void starts empty.
Draw a starting Hand of 4 cards.
A Contract card is taken from the Deck before shuffling, the player draws 3 and adds the Contract card (4 in Hand).
obligations.note: Adding the Contract card is optional in the manual: the human player gets an "Add to Hand / Keep in Deck" prompt (15-match.js, covered by void_supply_rules_tests.py and tests/unit/engine.test.mjs); the CPU always adds it (policy, not a rule gap). Re-checked 2026-10-27.

obligations.rule: Each player may redraw once: the whole Hand (a Contract card too) returns to the Deck, shuffle, draw 4; the Contract card is not added again.
The rock-paper-scissors winner chooses to go first or second.
obligations.note: Coin toss instead of rock-paper-scissors; the winner chooses.

obligations.rule: The first player's first turn skips only the Core Step and the Attack Step; the Draw Step is not skipped.
Core Step: 1 core from the Void to the Reserve.
Draw Step: draw 1 card.
Refresh Step: refresh all your cards and move the cores in your Trash (the Soul Core too) to the Reserve.
End Step: effects that last until the end of the turn end.
A player whose Deck has 0 cards at the start step of their own turn loses; an empty Deck at any other time is not a loss.
Only one Spirit in the Refresh state may block; blocking exhausts it; exhausted Spirits cannot block.
The Spirit with lower BP is destroyed; with equal BP both are destroyed.
An unblocked attack reduces the defender's Life by the attacker's symbols; the Life cores go to the defender's Reserve; Life 0 loses.
No attack on the first player's first turn (the Attack Step is skipped).
The Void is the core supply and has no limit; when it runs out, cores are added from outside the game.
Count Area cores come from the Void.
A Spirit with fewer cores than its LV1 is depleted, not destroyed: it goes to the Trash and its cores to the Reserve; destruction triggers do not fire.
The Soul Core is never put in the Void or Life; another core goes instead.
Cores on a Grandwalker Nexus go to the Void when it leaves the Field (the Soul Core to the Reserve).
obligations.test: grandwalker_void_tests.py:5 Soul Core on a Grandwalker Nexus goes to the Reserve

obligations.rule: A Grandwalker Nexus is unaffected by effects except its own and effects that target a Grandwalker Nexus.
obligations.source: Eternal manual FAQ (About Effects in General)
obligations.test: grandwalker_core_effects_tests.py:19 Ometeotl with a Soul Core is unaffected

obligations.rule: When-Manifests effects do not activate when the Manifest happens in the Main Step.
obligations.test: grandwalker_core_effects_tests.py:37 official rule: a Manifest in the Main Step

obligations.rule: By doing X, do Y: X is not done when Y cannot be done.
Simultaneous effects: the turn player decides the order; an effect activated by a resolving effect resolves first.
obligations.source: Eternal manual, Other Rules: About Activating Effects

obligations.rule: Once per Turn: Same Name allows one use for all copies of that name.
obligations.test: mitra_tests.py:second Ek cannot activate the same turn (Same Name)

obligations.rule: Banished cards leave the game (Banished zone).
obligations.source: not found in the online text yet
obligations.note: Engine behaviour; the manual page still has to be found.
obligations.test: by_doing_trigger_loop_tests.py:11 ... with a destroyed target: Soul Core to Ometeotl and the target is banished

obligations.rule: OC is active while your Count meets the OC condition, regardless of Lv; it adds its BP; [During OC] effects only while met.
(When Blocks) effects activate after the block is declared, in one pool with the attacker's 'when blocked' effects, before BP is compared.
(When Destroyed) effects resolve when the Spirit is destroyed (battle or effect), not when it is depleted, using the level it had.
obligations.note: The manual resolves them before the card is placed in the Trash; the engine moves the card first and resolves right after with the stored level.

obligations.rule: 'When this card is revealed from the deck' effects resolve while the revealing effect resolves.
obligations.source: not found in the manual (house ruling v0.33)
obligations.note: No manual rule; Magic reveals (Star Intention REVEAL_ADD) do not fire it yet.

obligations.rule: A Brave combines with a Spirit that meets its Brave condition (Main Step, or summoned directly combined) at no cost; its cores move onto the Spirit; BP+ and symbol are added; one Brave per Spirit.
An uncombined Brave on the Field is treated as a Spirit; summoning it is not a Spirit summon.
In the Main Step a combined Spirit can separate; the Brave needs cores for Lv1; a Spirit that no longer meets the condition separates at once and a Brave that cannot keep Lv1 goes to the Trash.
When the combined Spirit leaves the Field the Brave goes to the same place.
obligations.note: Soul State: the Brave goes to the Trash (house reading). Swaps and Brave-only removal are not wired.

obligations.rule: A Saga Brave can combine with a Grandwalker Nexus and adds its [While Combined with a Nexus] effect.
obligations.note: v0.35: combine (cores to the Reserve), direct summon without cores, separation with Lv1 cores, symbol and [While Combined with a Nexus] effects. The Nexus does not take the Brave's cost/family; the Brave's immunity to other effects is implicit (it is not a Field target).

obligations.rule: Ultimate, Seal, Heavy Exhaust, Unstackable.
obligations.source: Eternal manual (to read when that work starts)
obligations.note: Roadmap issue #4 after v0.35 (Token done).

obligations.rule: Token cards cannot be put into the Deck; they are prepared before the game, no limit per kind, not refilled during the game.
obligations.source: Eternal Rule Manual VER.17.0 p. 57; official "How to Use Token Cards" rule 1

obligations.rule: A Token goes to the Field only by a "send out" effect: no cost, cores for at least Lv1 from the Field or Reserve; it is not a summon.
obligations.source: Eternal Rule Manual VER.17.0 p. 56; official "How to Use Token Cards" rule 2

obligations.rule: A Token that leaves the Field returns to the Token supply (not Trash, Hand, Deck or Soul State); a Brave on it goes to the Trash; "after destroyed" Bursts cannot activate.
obligations.source: official "How to Use Token Cards" rule 3 and notes

obligations.rule: A Cost Destruction effect destroys an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with Cost N or less; the limit grows only through effects that say so (Bulwark Temple LV2, Railgun on a Nexus, five counters on Musketeer); lowest/highest-cost destruction has no limit.
obligations.source: card text read on cardrush-bs.jp (see manual-notes: Cost Destruction effect)

obligations.rule: The Temple bonus counts Saga Braves you control (also a Brave combined with a Spirit) and works only at LV2 for Celtica/Scalostle sources.
obligations.source: card text read on cardrush-bs.jp (see manual-notes: Cost Destruction effect)

obligations.rule: A Saga Brave combined with Contractor Nuadha gives its Contract Skill N: send N cores from the Nexus to the Void, Flash, either Attack Step.
obligations.source: card text read on cardrush-bs.jp (see manual-notes: Nexus Brave Contract Skill)

obligations.rule: A Brave summoned by an effect is a Spirit (Lv1, no cost) and can be combined in a later Main Step.
obligations.note: Direct combining by an effect (Goibniu LV2) and summon from the Trash are not built; the manual page is read through docs/manual-notes.md (Brave).

obligations.rule: Heavy Exhaust: only an effect applies it; the card cannot attack or block; one Refresh (Refresh Step or an effect) makes it a normal Exhausted card; a Refreshed or Exhausted Spirit can be targeted.
obligations.note: Shown as Exhausted; the upside-down picture needs UI approval.

obligations.rule: The Refresh Step turns a Heavy Exhausted card into a normal Exhausted card (not Refreshed).
obligations.source: Eternal manual p. 20 and FAQ p. 67 (inferred: the Refresh Step is a refresh)
obligations.note: The manual summary does not state the Refresh Step case explicitly; implemented as one refresh.

obligations.rule: Cards put onto the Removed Zone by Hermes-deck effects leave their zone; Spirits sent there give their cores to the Reserve; 'when cards are put onto the opposing Removed Zone' effects fire once per put event.
obligations.source: card text of the Hermes deck cards; no Removed Zone rule found in the Eternal manual text read 2026-10-14 (docs/manual-notes.md, Heavy Exhaust / Removed Zone)
obligations.note: Returning cards from the zone, 'can't use' locks and the Set Aside relation are not built.

obligations.rule: An effect can stop the opponent from activating Burst effects during one battle.
obligations.source: card text of Contractor Hermes (Contract Field); manual p. 48 names only Heavy Armor / Ultra Armor (docs/manual-notes.md)
obligations.note: Only Burst effects of the Burst Area are blocked; the lock ends with the battle.

obligations.rule: A Manifest printed '(Your Attack Step)' is a Flash only in the Attack Step of the Manifesting player.
obligations.source: card text of Sisyphus (Manifest, Your Attack Step); Manifest rule in docs/manual-notes.md

obligations.rule: Cores sent to the Reserve by an effect can leave a Spirit below its Lv1 cores: it is depleted (Trash, no Destruction effects) and draws only what the card says.
obligations.source: Eternal Rule Manual p. 28 (Depletion); card text of Vaplus

obligations.rule: "By discarding a card": the discard is the cost and is only done when the rest can be done; with an empty Hand nothing happens.
obligations.source: Eternal Rule Manual FAQ, About Effects in General Q5

obligations.rule: A once-per-turn limit that covers only the Count part of an effect does not stop the rest of the effect (Contractor Hades Contract Skill).
A Spirit under "can't attack/block" is never offered as an attacker or blocker and stays on the Field; the flag ends when it leaves the Field.
obligations.source: card text of Contractor Indra (Contract Skill); manual text not re-read in v0.40
obligations.note: The Eternal manual text on can't-attack/block effects was not re-read in v0.40; the "Neither player can ... prevented by opposing effects" clause (Vajrawurm Unleash) is not built.

obligations.rule: "By discarding your entire Hand": needs at least one card; the draw only happens when the discard was done.
obligations.source: Eternal Rule Manual FAQ, About Effects in General Q5

obligations.rule: An extra reduction symbol given by a Field card lowers the cost of matching cards in the Hand, only while its Level is active.
obligations.source: card text of Contractor Indra and Shimavajdra

obligations.rule: (Can't Stack): of several same-name cards the effect works once per event.
Sending a Life to a Spirit or a Void core to the Life is not a Life reduction by damage: no Burst; the last Life is never sent by an own effect.
obligations.source: card text of Vajdra-of-Magan and Naraka; engine ruling
obligations.note: Built as printed on the cards; the manual has no page for moving a Life core to a Spirit or a Void core to the Life, and the "last Life can't be sent" rule is an engine safeguard, not a manual rule.

obligations.rule: Magic clauses: sent-to-Trash triggers, use from the Trash (banished), attack/block core tax, Trash symbols for the cost, Hand protection, Hand trigger at the start of the opposing Attack Step, Burst then Main effect and Brave-summon activation.
obligations.source: card text of Whirling Tide, Thunder Counter, Hades Disaster, Plutonic Wall, Lightning Tempest, Dana Draw; engine ruling
obligations.note: Built as printed; the manual has no general rule for these clauses. House readings: only a spare core pays the Plutonic Wall tax; the human uses Trash Magic from the Flash Timing list.

obligations.rule: Seal: a Seal effect (SEAL action, Seal Manifest, Seal Contract Advent) moves your Soul Core to your Life; you are Sealed while it is there and [During Seal] effects apply; the Soul Core in Life counts as a Life core.
obligations.source: Eternal Rule Manual p.49 (Seal); p.28 (Soul Core places)
obligations.note: Life reduction choice is fixed (normal cores first, both players); no human prompt yet. Flag Contract Advent not built: the Flag Nexus rule box is missing from the Fandom export.

obligations.rule: Accel: use the Accel effect from the Hand at its timing by paying the Accel cost; afterwards the card goes to the Removed Zone; an Accel Spirit in the Removed Zone can be summoned in your Main Step by paying its cost; Accel can't be used from the Removed Zone.
obligations.source: Battle Spirits Fandom wiki, 'Accel' (Q1-Q8); no Accel section in the Eternal manual text read
obligations.note: Accel-cost reduction icons are not in the Fandom export: the full cost is paid until the cards are checked against images.

obligations.rule: Silver Wheel: a Flash effect whose cost is exhausting this card; 'when you activate Silver Wheel' effects trigger after it.
obligations.source: Printed card text (Fandom export BS70-BS76); Eternal Rule Manual p.18/p.23 (Flash effects also in the Main Step)
obligations.note: SILVER_WHEEL trigger is built but no promoted card uses it yet (Contractor Brigit's Contract Field needs the Contract Nexus data).

obligations.rule: Invoke (Standard activation): '<cost> > <effect>' after {{Invoke|Flash}} / {{Invoke|Main}}; the cost part must resolve in full or the effect is not used; Flash = Flash Timings and your Main Step, Main = your Main Step; printed step / (During Attack) / (During Block) heads and (Once Per Turn) / (Once Per Battle) limits apply.
obligations.source: Standard manual 'FAQ on Effects' Q11; Standard CR 12-2-1-4 / 12-2-1-5 (Main / Flash timings)
obligations.note: Costs built: pay N, exhaust/destroy this card, exhaust one of your (family) Nexuses/Spirits, discard a family card. Open: conditional costs ('If ..., exhaust this Spirit'), core moves, returning cards, Change templates.

obligations.rule: 'If your Life was reduced (during) this turn': true when any core left the owner's Life during the current turn (attack or effect); checked when the effect resolves; 'X instead' = the bound or target count changes.
obligations.source: Card texts of the Standard Magic Sharp Thorn, Punish Gate, Flame Hurricane (Fandom export); manual-notes 'S1 conditions'
obligations.note: v0.88.0 S1: condition lifeReduced (p.lifeRedTurn set by lifeTake).

obligations.rule: 'If all your Spirits/Nexuses have X' (family or [Team: X]) and 'If all your Spirits are Cost 2/4/6/8 with the X family': every card of that kind on your Field matches; none at all = not met.
obligations.source: Card texts Burai Kick, Sengoku Fire Dance, Flash Run (Fandom export); manual-notes 'S1 conditions'
obligations.note: v0.88.0 S1: condition allHave (02p-effects-shared-shapes.js). The empty-Field reading (not met) is not yet confirmed by a manual or Q&A.
